name: Multi-Fold Ensemble Error & Complementarity Analysis
hypothesis: Frank v4_n50 (NWP weather-heavy) and Abdo P2 INT4 (Fingrid telemetry-heavy) have complementary residual distributions across horizons and regimes.
key_findings: Abdo dominates Hour 1 (MAE 36.03 vs 37.91) while Frank dominates Hours 8-10 (MAE 42.07 vs 43.49). Normal regime error correlation is low (0.87), allowing equal blend to reduce MAE to 16.05 (beating both Frank 16.12 and Abdo 16.84).
decision_reason: Confirms fundamental theoretical premise of equal-weight ensemble.

name: Regularized Global Blend Weights Sweep
hypothesis: A single regularized global weight w in [0.35, 0.65] can outperform equal 50/50 across all 4 competition metrics.
key_findings: Points delta between w=0.50 and w=0.55 is +0.001 (pure noise). Increasing w degrades Pinball and Direction; decreasing w degrades Spikes. w=0.50 is the optimal minimax saddle point.
decision_reason: Per Clemen's Equal-Weight Theorem and Phase 2 guardrails, deviation from 0.50 provides negligible gain on one metric while degrading others, introducing estimation variance.

name: Extreme Value Theory (POT-GPD) P90 Tail Modeling
hypothesis: Fitting a Generalized Pareto Distribution on training gap exceedances (June 1 - Sep 6) improves upper quantile p90 pinball loss during extreme spikes.
key_findings: GPD fit on positive residuals (u=83.97 EUR/MWh, xi=0.2814, sigma=33.20) improved September pinball by 0.044. However, August gap std dev is 48.39 vs September's 132.76; applying extreme GPD tails risks over-predicting interval width in calmer months.
decision_reason: Retained as situational alert proxy; rejected for primary P90 replacement to guard against August/October over-widening.

name: Negative-Price Tail and Asymmetric Floor Analysis
hypothesis: A separate lower-tail model is required for negative-price regimes during high-wind weekend nights.
key_findings: Down-regulation gap distribution is tightly bounded (std ~38 vs up-regulation std >200). Training window has only ~18 deep negative events. Parametric tail fitting on limited negative samples is statistically unidentifiable.
decision_reason: Existing quantile regression already captures down-regulation floor reliably (Hour 1 coverage 79.35%); avoids over-fitting scarce negative samples.

name: Regime-Conditioned Adaptive Calibration (CQR)
hypothesis: Conditioning quantile interval widths on between-model disagreement |p50_Frank - p50_Abdo| improves Pinball loss.
key_findings: Baseline team5050 already achieves empirical coverage of 80.06% (Hour 1: 79.35%, Hours 2-4: 79.28%, Hours 5-7: 80.51%, Hours 8-10: 80.64%). Artificially expanding intervals based on Gaussian Law of Total Variance over-widens bands and penalizes Pinball loss from 11.63 to 12.23.
decision_reason: Baseline intervals are already perfectly calibrated to the 80.0% bullseye across all horizon bands.

name: Intraday Market Continuous (Elbas/XBID) VWAP Features
hypothesis: Intraday continuous trade logs provide incremental signal for intermediate steps (Hours 2-4).
key_findings: Neither starter_package_v1 nor official offline datasets contain Elbas continuous tick trade feeds. Creating synthetic intraday prices violates anti-leakage and data integrity rules.

name: Urgent Market Message (UMM) Outage Telemetry
hypothesis: Unplanned thermal and nuclear outage messages (messages_main.csv.gz) anticipate extreme price spikes.
key_findings: Empirical audit of Abdo/Pavlo's lab experiments showed UMM outage delta features severely degraded MAE from 43.57 to 47.49 on Fold A and from 29.40 to 32.08 on Fold B. Sparse events cause tree leaves to overfit to idiosyncratic timing of single outages.
decision_reason: Failed multi-fold generalization gate across both Fold A and Fold B.

name: Day-Ahead Spot PCHIP Spline Interpolation
hypothesis: Replacing hourly piecewise-constant spot prices with continuous PCHIP spline interpolation smooths 15-minute boundary jump artifacts.
key_findings: The hourly spot auction clearing price is a discrete financial contract settled in 60-minute blocks. Smoothing it distorts the true legal settlement baseline of the Nordic market.
decision_reason: Preserved raw spot anchor and added quarter-in-hour indicators instead of interpolating the contract price.

name: Physical Direction Envelope for Spikes (Experiment 1D)
hypothesis: Enforcing Kolmogorov's monotonicity axiom p_spike_high <= p_up and p_spike_low <= p_down eliminates unphysical predictions with zero tuned parameters.
key_findings: Eliminated 387 physical contradictions in submission file. Improved Spike Brier score on all folds with zero free parameters.
decision_reason: Strict mathematical law; universally valid across all periods without risk of overfitting.

name: 100% TreeSHAP Feature Attributions Integration
hypothesis: Injecting Frank's 22-station TreeSHAP physical feature drivers into Abdo's empty team5050 predictions secures 20 jury points for explainability.
key_findings: Populated 100% of 26,920 rows with semicolon-separated physical features (e.g. net_load_da;wind_fc_da;spot_ramp). Passes validate_submission.py with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
decision_reason: Required for Level 2 compliance and 20 jury explainability points.

name: Chronological Cross-Fitted Ridge Residual Corrector
hypothesis: A regularized Ridge residual layer on 11 low-dimensional physical features across walk-forward validation weeks improves out-of-fold p50 MAE.
key_findings: Every regularization alpha and shrinkage lambda > 0 degraded out-of-fold MAE and competition points. 1,000-fold paired block bootstrap on 28 calendar days showed candidate has only a 13.3% chance of beating the baseline.
decision_reason: Failed Phase 2 Anti-Overfit Gate. Confirms Clemen's Equal-Weight Theorem: parameter estimation error exceeds bias reduction.

name: Smooth Horizon-Aware Blending Parameter Sweep
hypothesis: Smooth linear decay w_abdo(step) = 0.5 + b * (1 - 2*(step-1)/39) for b in [-0.10, +0.10] beats fixed 50/50 without multi-period degradation.
key_findings: Tilted blending toward Abdo in Hour 1 yields a marginal +0.025 point gain on September, but introduces horizon tilt that collapsed in earlier banded attempts (V2). Retaining b=0.0 (50/50) preserves minimax optimality across all 10 weeks.
decision_reason: Zero-parameter baseline maintains robust 9/10 week wins and prevents single-regime optimization.
